items.title: Hologic signs agreement to acquire Reveal Genomics (HER2DX breast cancer test)
items.summary: Hologic has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Barcelona-based Reveal Genomics, maker of the HER2DX test for HER2-positive breast cancer, to complement its Breast Cancer Index test. Closing is subject to Spanish regulatory approval and customary conditions; price not disclosed in the release.
items.source: Hub intelligence

items.title: Agilent to acquire Proscia (digital pathology software) for up to $270m
items.summary: Agilent has agreed to buy digital pathology software company Proscia in an all-cash deal: $240m at closing plus up to $30m of milestones. Closing is expected early in Agilent's fiscal 2027, subject to customary conditions; Proscia will join Agilent's Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets Group.
